correctness.rationale: A formal series is a unit exactly when its constant term is a unit. Under the 2-nonunit hypothesis each constant-term fiber is independent and every base edge expands to a complete bipartite join. A base total dominating set lifts; conversely a finite minimum upstairs set projects to a total dominating set because each infinite fiber contains an unselected vertex. The local-ring corollary follows from the complete multipartite residue graph. The finite truncation checker is corroborative only.

originality.rationale: The power-series graph is exactly an independent-fiber lexicographic blow-up of the finite base graph under the stated hypothesis. A published lexicographic-product theorem already states that ordinary domination of G composed with any nontrivial H having domination number at least two equals total domination of G. Finite edgeless H gives this identity verbatim, and passing from a finite edgeless fiber to an infinite edgeless fiber uses the same one-line projection argument. Thus the claimed transfer is theorem-level prior implication rather than a new domination phenomenon.
